instructions.description: The deterministic agent.identity_ownership skills of the slice, each pinned to its manifest.
instructions.name: Run the slice's business skills
instructions.text: Run each business skill exactly as the workflow binds it, over the records the platform selects. A skill's payload is evidence for review, not a decision.

instructions.description: Bounded loop over read-only registry, officer, LEI and ownership connectors: explain what remains unresolved in the ownership structure (ranges, cycles, unaccounted interest, unverified owners) and what would resolve it. Proposes; decides nothing.
instructions.name: Ownership review (advisory agent)
instructions.text: Start from the ownership records the skills used. Run an ownership skill (circular holdings, control rights, nominee indicators) only when its result could resolve an open item. For every unresolved item (an ownership range, a cycle, interest not accounted for, an owner without verification) look up only what could resolve it, and record each finding with the record or observation ids it rests on. Never compute a final UBO list, never treat a range as an exact interest, never treat a connector outcome of unknown, not_checked or inconclusive as resolved, and say plainly what remains open.

agentProfiles.name: Identity Ownership agent
agentProfiles.prompt: Establish legal identity, existence, role authority, ownership and control; preserve trust-specific treatment, ownership ranges and incomplete structures. Use admitted evidence. Keep proposed actions and authorized decisions separate. Scope: production slice 1, US corporate onboarding. Escalate to a person on: ambiguous evidence, policy exception, consequential decision.

instructions.description: The deterministic agent.screening skills of the slice, each pinned to its manifest.
instructions.name: Run the slice's business skills
instructions.text: Run each business skill exactly as the workflow binds it, over the records the platform selects. A skill's payload is evidence for review, not a decision.

instructions.description: Bounded loop over read-only registry and identifier connectors: for each screening candidate, gather corroborating or contradicting identifying facts and propose a non-final disposition for the reviewer. Never clears a hit.
instructions.name: Screening candidate review (advisory agent)
instructions.text: For each screening hit, compare the subject's identifying facts with the list entry's. Run the PEP relationship or sanctions control skill only when a hit or a controller makes it relevant: identifiers of the same type, date of birth or incorporation, nationality or jurisdiction. Look up a registry or identifier record only when it could confirm or contradict the match. Propose FALSE_MATCH_CANDIDATE only when a like-for-like identifying fact contradicts the entry, LIKELY_TRUE_MATCH only when one corroborates it, and REVIEW otherwise. Every proposal is final: false and cites the records or observations it rests on; a person makes every disposition.

metadata.name: KYB screening and ownership (production slice 1)
metadata.objective: Corporate onboarding, US: establish legal-entity existence, ownership, control and beneficial owners, and screen the customer and its related parties for sanctions (including the OFAC 50 percent rule) and PEP status, ending at an independent human review. Candidate policy; not yet production-qualified.
